text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, excuse me over there.
Could I trouble you to assist me for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No need to be so guarded.
Come on, follow me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Fuji Kiseki, I found
a little girl crying with scraped knees.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks for waiting, little crying pony.
No blinking allowed—behold the show!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to cast some magic on this coin now.
One, two, three――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that instant――
the coin vanished cleanly from Fuji Kiseki's hand.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, time for the assistant's turn!
Check inside your pocket.
choice_data_list: I slipped it in secretly earlier—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Shh. It's impressive you noticed, but
you must strictly keep it to yourself.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides... rather than dwelling on boring details,
isn't it more important that this little one stopped crying?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Whoa, why over here...?! Show me more~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu. To answer your lovely encore, let's do one more round. Assistant, I'll be counting on you again!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
Magic power! I like the sound of that!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing!
Big sis, are you a wizard!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, indeed I did. I have proof too.
Here, go ahead. Why don't you check your other pocket?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Yet another coin emerged
from the opposite pocket.
